exposure: Second-trimester uterine artery (UtA) Doppler parameters (notching, pulsatility index)
cohort: 800 pregnant women (87 with GDM and 723 with normal glucose tolerance).
finding: Second-trimester UtA Doppler ultrasonography, particularly the presence of bilateral UtA notching and a mean UtA PI > 1.195, showed promise in predicting GDM, while triple test analytes did not.
